What I'm proposing:
- Staging: CP Warehouse B (address in drive link below)
- Staging window: Apr 8–10 (devices arrive to CP Warehouse B for packing)
- Fleet pickup: Apr 12–13 (one 26ft truck per site)
- Items: 42 docked workstations, 12 laptops (loaners), 3 standing desks (disassembled)

Attachments: staging_checklist_2026-04-07.xlsx (staging tasks + labeling schema)

Next steps (please reply with yes/no and any red flags):
- Lauren: confirm coworking headcount and which desks are reserved for long-term seats
- Dev: confirm imaging process + any hardware wipes needed before return
- Olivia/CP: confirm FleetShip booking and PO flow

Thanks — trying to keep this tight so ops can book transport and we can avoid extra storage fees.

— Marcus
